name: Noise Layer Evaluation
definition: Evaluates a single procedural noise layer for volume or terrain shading, supporting multiple noise types, positional distortion, power scaling, and inversion.
summary: Noise Layer Evaluation is a procedural shading technique that computes a single noise value for volume rendering by encapsulating layer configuration into a unified pipeline, distinguishing itself from sibling methods that focus on low-level gradient interpolation or distance-based metrics.
